KMNO-EUR.summary: KMNO has a scheduled September 30, 2026 vesting unlock—four days after the signal snapshot—of about 229.2M tokens (2.29% of max supply), allocated to investor/team insiders. This is a near-term supply-event risk.
materialRisks: A September 30, 2026 unlock of approximately 229.2M KMNO is scheduled, equal to about 2.29% of the 10B maximum supply and reported as roughly 6.37% of circulating supply.
The scheduled tranche is attributed to investor and core-contributor/team allocations, creating a concentrated near-term supply-release event.

facts.fact: Multiple current unlock trackers independently list the next KMNO unlock for September 30, 2026, four calendar days after the September 26, 2026 snapshot.
The reported unlock amount is approximately 229.17M KMNO, or about 2.29% of maximum supply.
Reported allocation breakdown is approximately 145.83M investor tokens plus 83.33M team/core-contributor tokens.
No directly relevant Kamino exploit, outage, exchange maintenance action, or regulatory action was identified in the fresh sources reviewed.
